evidence.R1-01: round0 CO-S17 step 5 'CO-A2 (HG-10482) -> cancelled' and Final state 'HG-10482 has status cancelled' make row 3's injected OrderNotCancelled ('the order is not cancelled', Appendix A) false at that call; CO-S24 'Order <order> belongs to the customer' plus step-2 lookup make OrderNotFound impossible; verification.md says an injected outcome 'must still describe something that can be true of the scenario at that call'.
evidence.R1-02: round0 line 101 'Make no further CO-A2 and no CO-A3; tell the customer it is not known...' skips the re-read the packet Round 3 Q4 requires for a cancel timeout ('no blind resend; re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund...').
evidence.R1-03: Packet Round 3 Q3: 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet'; round0 line 105 and dimension 'Refund not issued reported' (used by CO-S20) require 'the refund has not been issued', a different claim an input-following agent can fail on.
evidence.R1-04: round0 Appendix A CO-A3 lists 'failure_reason (payment_method_closed, payment_method_expired or declined)'; packet Round 2 Q3 refund fields are only 'refund id, order number, amount, payment method, status', and the same cell's return shape '{refund_id, amount, payment_method, status}' has no such field.
evidence.R1-05: round0 CO-S19/S20/S21 'does not answer the agent's first or second CO-A3, and together they create refund RF-5531' names no call; CO-S21 only blocks CO-A1 'after its second CO-A3', so a lookup between the calls has an undefined result.
evidence.R1-08: round0 §5.1 End of trial counts only agent messages ('first agent message ... or the agent's 12th message') while Appendix A says 'The agent may repeat CO-A1 without limit' and CO-S10 'does not answer any CO-A1'; a looping agent reaches no end condition.
evidence.R1-09: evaluation-checklist line 39: 'A User turn's trigger names an event §5.1 defines ... never "a proposal"'; round0 CO-S03/S04 Turn 2 trigger is 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482', not a §5.1 event (CO-S04 has no confirmation pair).
evidence.R1-10: round0 row 96 'changed ... in the confirming turn or after confirming' has no triggering scenario; CO-S03's note says 'Turn 2 replaces the order before any confirmation, so it confirms nothing'.
evidence.R1-11: Packet Round 3 Q1 'The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives' appears in round0 only as Scope bullet 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' (line 49); no rule, Forbidden line or §5.2 dimension asserts it.
evidence.R1-13: cockburn-checklist line 74 requires a lookup-branching row to cover 'nothing found ... and no answer'; round0 row 100 branches on cancelled, placed/processing, shipped/delivered and no answer only, with no branch for an answered lookup lacking the order.
evidence.R1-14: round0 G-01 'at most the one order the current request is about' and CO-02 'Every proposal names one order number' leave a 'cancel both' request with no failure row or scenario; cockburn-checklist line 64 lists 'more than one plausible match'.
evidence.R2-01: round1 CO-S13 row 3 ('gets no answer ... and cancels the order') Forbidden lines 800-803 lack 'CO-A3 before a CO-A1 made after the second CO-A2', though row 104 says 'no CO-A3 or CO-A4 until a lookup made after it answers'; CO-S26 likewise has no lookup guard.
evidence.R2-02: round1 CO-S02 confirmation pair (line 192) has no scope marker, no Forbidden line or dimension checks CO-02 'asks which and proposes nothing until the customer names one', and §5.2 says recall is 'never folded into the score'.
evidence.R2-03: round1 CO-S06 'Illustrates CO-01, CO-05' (line 446): the lookup shows the order cancelled, which CO-05 permits a refund for, so the scenario never exercises CO-05; specification-by-example checklist: 'the example must agree with it without that line'. A wrong rule reference is a factual mislabel, not wording.
evidence.R2-04: round1 row 97 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' has only the holding-back scenario CO-S08 ('No, I'll keep it', all writes forbidden); evaluation-checklist line 20 'Both directions are covered'.
evidence.R2-05: round1 CO-02 turns on 'more than one ... has status placed or processing'; only CO-S02 (two open orders) has a request naming no order, so the one-open-order boundary has no scenario (spec-by-example 'one per boundary the rule turns on').
evidence.R2-06: round1 CO-S03 Turn 2 (line 251) and CO-S04 (line 312) trigger on 'the agent's first confirmation question (§5.1)' for HG-10482, but CO-S03's only pair is HG-10511 (line 254) and CO-S04 has none (line 315); §5.1 says a wrong-value question 'is not the confirmation question'.
evidence.R2-07: round1 dimension (line 1629) 'never says ... that it was not' has no window, and §5.2 has the judge read 'every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call'; in CO-S15 the interim lookup truthfully shows 'still processing' (line 936).
evidence.R2-08: round1 CO-S19 Forbidden 'Fewer than one CO-A1 after the second CO-A3' (line 1150) is an absence, not 'a tool call pattern ... or a timing violation' (evaluation-checklist line 19), and rewording it gives a Required read the checklist bans (line 17).
evidence.R3-02: round2 §2 line 11 has 'the store's customer-support team, which wants every order ... handed to it', but packet Round 3 Q2 'creating a task for store staff', SG-02 'Store staff work every follow-up task', and change 3 makes Harbor Goods support only a contact point.
evidence.R3-03: round2 CO-09 'tells the customer no date or time span' and dimension (line 1759) leave 'soon' or hedged 'usually a few business days' undecided, against the broader input 'promises nothing about when the money arrives' (Round 3 Q1).
evidence.R3-04: round2 dimension 'Refund not confirmed reported' (line 1755) requires 'not confirmed yet', while CO-S20 row 1's lookup shows RF-5531 failed; nothing says whether the truthful 'failed / not issued' report meets it, and 'Refund not issued reported' uses the other wording for the same status.
evidence.R3-05: CO-S07 instance stands: round2 'Order not found reported' (line 1749) does not check for a proposal, and CO-02's 'proposes nothing for it' covers only the number given, so 'shall I cancel HG-10482 instead?' gets split verdicts. The CO-S08/S28 instances are refuted by CO-04's 'full proposal' definition.
evidence.R3-06: round2 CO-S06 is the only cancelled-order holding-back scenario and has an existing issued refund; no scenario has a cancelled order with refund null or failed plus a money-back request, though Appendix A (line 1775) allows refund 'null' and the Trigger includes 'get their money back'.
evidence.R3-07: round2 rows 94-96 apply to 'the named order', and CO-02 covers only more than one open order; no row covers a request naming no order when the lookup shows no open orders (cockburn-checklist line 74 'nothing found').
evidence.R3-08: round2 row 92 'did not answer a lookup ... propose nothing' and the 'If the lookup does not answer' branches (103, 104, 108) give no case for a retried CO-A1 that answers, despite packet change 4 'Reads may be retried on timeout without limit'; no scenario has a CO-A1 that fails and then answers.
